isolatedElectronCapabilityCheck.meaning: Runtime capabilities only; current editor layout remains CPU work and does not use a Worker.

formalCoreQualification.scope: Completed before six new Desktop installation regression cases were added; those cases are included in the final complete browser run. The formal WASM is unchanged.

plainCellOwnedUndo.layer: Common Studio input-history/deferred-pagination adapter; no additional Rust patch
plainCellOwnedUndo.scope: One-depth plain cell insertion with no newline/tab, pending character format, replaced text or saved paragraph fragment
plainCellOwnedUndo.change: Cancel the pending preview before the synchronous deletion inverse which already owns complete pagination; preserve the failure barrier.
plainCellOwnedUndo.finalWholeBrowserSuite: passed: 474 tests, 460 passed, zero failed, 14 environment-specific exclusions
plainCellOwnedUndo.electronLatencyScope: Controlled actual Electron comparison only; see controlledElectronMeasurement for diagnostic baseline and excluded/unresolved attempts. Not a final installer benchmark.

formalBrowserQualification.scope: Complete browser-configured suite, including the six new Desktop installation regression cases. Core/browser sets overlap and are not additive.
formalBrowserQualification.exclusions: Live-account, native-window and explicitly optional fixture checks require separate prerequisites.

controlledElectronMeasurement.host: Actual packaged Electron shell, displayed inactive windows, fresh isolated profiles; not the installed application or an MSI upgrade benchmark
controlledElectronMeasurement.baseline: Pre-performance candidate core with the same final UI, except a test-response override returns plain-cell Undo to its previous flush-first boundary. This is a controlled diagnostic baseline, not a previously released installer.
controlledElectronMeasurement.final: Formal twenty-two-patch core and final shared editor bundle without the baseline Undo override
controlledElectronMeasurement.timingBoundary: Trusted keyboard dispatch through two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; excludes startup and does not measure physical-screen presentation

excludedAttempts.reason: The harness replaced a recorded array instead of resetting it in place; native-call recording was invalid.
Hidden-window frame callbacks waited roughly two seconds, so this was not a displayed-input latency measurement.
An initial displayed final-candidate attempt lost the selected cell range after five repeated keys. The cause remains unconfirmed; later successful sessions do not explain the failure.
excludedAttempts.evidenceLimit: The attempt ended before detailed native-key/focus traces and a failure screenshot were preserved.

limitations: One machine and one complex document. The controlled baseline is not the previously installed release.
Selection loss in one excluded attempt remains unresolved; success of the six valid sessions is not a claim that all attempts passed.
Typing medians were 101.6 ms and 98.4 ms with overlapping variation; no typing-speed improvement is claimed.
Internal timings overlap end-to-end timings and must not be added.

Event defaultPrevented was sampled after the capture listener in a microtask, not as a reliable final-after-handler result. Trusted state, Ctrl/repeat, target, DOM focus and native-call counts were recorded separately.

selectionFollowup.host: Displayed inactive isolated Electron window; trusted CDP keyboard events with DOM textarea focus
selectionFollowup.purpose: Functional repeated-input verification, not a latency measurement
selectionFollowup.postArrowUndoSelectionReset: One expected reset from explicit Ctrl+Z through the existing history-jump selection reset; no selection loss occurred during arrow input.
selectionFollowup.limitation: The initial selection-loss attempt was not reproduced in this 50-key follow-up; this does not establish its cause or absence in all environments.

historicalBrowserRuns.scope: Completed whole suite. Two Windows Codex-plugin installation fixtures failed during directory publication; final qualification remains unresolved. Core/browser test sets overlap and are not additive.

failures.operation: publish staged marketplace by directory rename

desktopPluginPublication.layer: Pwh Desktop installer/plugin integration, not the rhwp core or shared editor
desktopPluginPublication.change: Bounded retry for Windows directory publication; validate a concurrently published destination before treating the race as success. Persistent failure remains an error and unmanaged paths are not overwritten.

qualificationScope: Fixed core/editor functional results and controlled performance measurements; the unresolved initial selection observation and excluded trials remain part of the record. Installer verification is separate.
